title: Marlin K. Jensen
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Kathleen Bushnell 1967, Salt Lake Temple; eight children
Third generation Bishop to Huntsville Ward
President of New York Rochester Mission
Released from the First Quorum and granted Emeritus Status 2012
